section_dispositions.reason: Passive cooldown recovery belongs with the empowerment cycle rather than a separate recognition card.
Projectile collision, splash and slowing define the base poke threat.
The delayed field creates a distinct avoidance goal; spell-shield behavior remains advanced and numerical change notes are excluded.
Recognizing and breaking the tether is a distinct response to the delayed root.
Self-healing and the extended root change enemy commitment decisions; bug notes remain outside core learning.
Targeted shielding and speed have a distinct defensive and repositioning purpose.
Group shielding and acceleration are recognizably different from the targeted base cast.
The system card explains empowerment selection, early availability and rank dependence together with passive recovery.
